tools.name: agroapi_list_polygons
tools.description: List your polygons with id, name, area in hectares and centre. Start here to find a polygon id for the other tools. GET /polygons.

tools.name: agroapi_get_polygon
tools.description: Get one polygon by id: geometry, name, area and centre. GET /polygons/{id}.

tools.name: agroapi_create_polygon
tools.description: Create a polygon (a field) from a GeoJSON Feature with a Polygon geometry, in [longitude, latitude] order. The vendor blocks a duplicate unless duplicated=true. Writes to your account. POST /polygons.

tools.name: agroapi_update_polygon
tools.description: Change the name of one polygon. Writes to your account. PUT /polygons/{id}.

tools.name: agroapi_delete_polygon
tools.description: Delete one polygon from your account. This cannot be undone through the API. DELETE /polygons/{id}.

tools.name: agroapi_search_images
tools.description: Find satellite images (Landsat-8 and Sentinel-2) of a polygon between two Unix times, with each image date and its image, tile and statistics links. The API key is removed from the links; add your own appid to open them. GET /image/search.

tools.name: agroapi_get_ndvi_history
tools.description: Get NDVI (vegetation index) statistics for a polygon over a time range. Choose the satellite with type: l8 (Landsat-8) or s2 (Sentinel-2). The vendor limits the long archive to its Corporate account. GET /ndvi/history.

tools.name: agroapi_get_current_weather
tools.description: Get the current weather at a latitude and longitude. GET /weather.

tools.name: agroapi_get_forecast_weather
tools.description: Get the 5-day weather forecast with 3-hour steps at a latitude and longitude. GET /weather/forecast.

tools.name: agroapi_get_historical_weather
tools.description: Get past weather at a latitude and longitude between two Unix times. Not in the free account. GET /weather/history.

tools.name: agroapi_get_accumulated_temperature
tools.description: Get the accumulated temperature (growing degree sum above a threshold) at a latitude and longitude between two Unix times. Not in the free account. GET /weather/history/accumulated_temperature.

tools.name: agroapi_get_accumulated_precipitation
tools.description: Get the accumulated precipitation at a latitude and longitude between two Unix times. Not in the free account. GET /weather/history/accumulated_precipitation.

tools.name: agroapi_get_current_soil
tools.description: Get the current soil temperature and moisture for a polygon. GET /soil.

tools.name: agroapi_get_historical_soil
tools.description: Get soil temperature and moisture for a polygon between two Unix times. Not in the free account. GET /soil/history.

tools.name: agroapi_get_current_uvi
tools.description: Get the current UV index for a polygon. GET /uvi.

tools.name: agroapi_get_forecast_uvi
tools.description: Get the UV index forecast for a polygon. cnt limits the number of values. GET /uvi/forecast.

tools.name: agroapi_get_historical_uvi
tools.description: Get the UV index for a polygon between two Unix times. Not in the free account. GET /uvi/history.
